spanish: Y harás sobre el joshen cadenillas de borde, obra de cordón, oro puro.

findings.issue: הַחֹשֶׁן is a common noun (definite, masculine singular). joshen leaves that lemma untranslated; a common noun stays Spanish.
H1383 גַּבְלֻת is the noun ‘twisted/wreathen work’. borde supplies the boundary/edge sense, which this lemma does not license.
שַׁרְשֹׁת is a feminine plural construct. cadenillas adds a diminutive size the plural morphology does not mark.

notes: Y harás, sobre, obra de cordón, and oro puro match the remaining tokens.
